commits.author: trevor@twentyideas.com <trevor@twentyideas.com>
commits.subject: Publish pull request review slides through apply-slide and diagram sources
commits.body:
apply-slide resolves the deck a request names: a feature implementation
deck, or with "review" (or --review, or the review deck's URN) an open
review's deck. Both share one transaction path, record, and content-
addressed SVG and diagram sidecars; the deck names its own slide and Item
URNs, so candidate validation and the semantic diff follow it.

A review Item's code stays with cover: the request refuses evidence and
criterion links, the loader attaches cover's flat records to review
transaction Items, and apply-slide refuses to drop an Item whose coverage
would be orphaned. A hand-written review slide migrates on its first
update with its coverage intact. diagram describe/get/edit/check accept
--review or a review slide's URN, and add-item and set-slide-content
guard review transaction slides like implementation ones.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.author: trevor@twentyideas.com <trevor@twentyideas.com>
commits.subject: Flag proposals that take in new lines, show neighbouring hunks, and refuse brace-only anchors
commits.body:
A proposal is widened whenever it takes in lines the pinned range did not
have, not only when a hunk crosses its edge, so a sibling function git slid
inside the range is flagged. Its diff shows the nearest hunk just before and
after the range, so an extracted helper or move is visible. Nothing is
proposed when the only lines an edit left in the range are braces, blank, or
punctuation, which anchor nothing.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: Merge feature/review-deck-diagrams: diagram-sourced review slides (PR #10)
commits.body:
Review decks author slides with the same apply-slide transaction and
diagram sources as implementation decks (`apply-slide --review ID`), so
creating a review never needs hand-written SVG. Review Items are covered
with cover --changed-lines, and that coverage survives slide revisions;
apply-slide refuses to drop a covered or commented review Item. diagram,
visual-qa, query slide, and apply-slide --print-current address review
slides; merged reviews stay history. The loader attaches evidence to
review Items published through slide transactions.
